description:
Adds or changes details on a quote. Objects merge; lists replace whole.

    data uses these keys (field_guide lists every accepted field and value):
    - applicants: list of every person in the household. Exactly one has relationToInsured INSURED.
      Each needs firstName, lastName, dateOfBirth, sex, maritalStatus; drivers also need isDriver true
      and driverDetails.licenseState. Lists replace whole, so always resend everyone.
    - auto: residenceType, priorInsurance, vehicles (list; each needs a vin, or year+make+model+subModel
      from lookup_vehicle, plus ownershipStatus, primaryUse, annualMileage).
    - home: coverage.dwellingCoverage (estimated rebuild cost in dollars), property (yearBuilt,
      squareFootage, constructionType, roofMaterial, roofUpdateYear, ...), utilities, underwriting, claims.
    - Top level: dateOfBirth, lengthAtCurrentAddress, email, phone, primaryAddress.
    Coverage limits are set by the agency and cannot be sent here.
    Returns a short summary of what is on file and the remaining missing items.
name: update_quote
title: Update quote details
